def choose_move(observation):
    # Defensive access to observation fields
    positions = observation.get('positions', [])
    resources = observation.get('resources', [])
    opponents = observation.get('opponents', [])
    territories = observation.get('territories', [])
    self_pos = observation.get('self', {})
    team_state = observation.get('team_state', {})

    # Get current position
    my_x = self_pos.get('x', 0)
    my_y = self_pos.get('y', 0)

    # Initialize move to stay still
    dx, dy = 0, 0

    # If resources are available, move towards the closest resource
    if resources:
        def dist(r):
            return abs(r.get('x', 0) - my_x) + abs(r.get('y', 0) - my_y)
        target = min(resources, key=dist)
        tx, ty = target.get('x', my_x), target.get('y', my_y)
        dx = 0 if tx == my_x else (1 if tx > my_x else -1)
        dy = 0 if ty == my_y else (1 if ty > my_y else -1)
        return [dx, dy]

    # If opponents are present and pursuit is feasible
    if opponents:
        def opp_dist(o):
            return abs(o.get('x', 0) - my_x) + abs(o.get('y', 0) - my_y)
        target = min(opponents, key=opp_dist)
        tx, ty = target.get('x', my_x), target.get('y', my_y)
        dx = 0 if tx == my_x else (1 if tx > my_x else -1)
        dy = 0 if ty == my_y else (1 if ty > my_y else -1)
        return [dx, dy]

    # Territory control: move towards the most claimed territory cell
    if territories:
        def terr_claimed(t):
            return t.get('claimers', 0)
        target = max(territories, key=terr_claimed)
        tx, ty = target.get('x', my_x), target.get('y', my_y)
        dx = 0 if tx == my_x else (1 if tx > my_x else -1)
        dy = 0 if ty == my_y else (1 if ty > my_y else -1)
        return [dx, dy]

    # Default: stay still if no other directives
    return [0, 0]
